summary: Investing.com -- Goldman Sachs downgraded European banks to “neutral” and insurers to “underweight” from “neutral” in its 2027 equity outlook, citing expectations of lower bond yields that could weigh on the sectors, which tend to be positively correlated with yields.

title: Goldman Sachs Forecasts Copper Prices to Reach $15,600 per Tonne by December 2027
summary: Goldman Sachs expects copper prices on the London Metal Exchange (LME) to reach $15,600 per tonne by December 2027, representing an increase of approximately 13% from current spot levels. The investment bank’s forecast follows a period of rising copper prices, with the metal trading at just under $10,000 per tonne during the previous year.
